title: Topology Obstructs Pure Foundation Neural Quantum States
abstract: arXiv:2609.07591v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models for ground states in spin-1/2 systems are a promising method for problems ranging from quantum chemistry to identifying new phase diagrams. Nearly all such models are currently pure-states that condition on the Hamiltonian's parameters, whose Monte Carlo samples give energy estimates according to the variational principle. In this contribution, we show that this representation is topologically obstructed. For any gapped Hamiltonian family whose ground-state bundle is non-trivial, every continuous normalized state-vector model has zero fidelity with the ground state at some parameter value in the Hamiltonian family. For that value, the energy is at least one spectral gap, $\Delta$, with an $O(\Delta)$ gap in an open-neighbourhood of that point. We show that this is a sufficient no-go also in the case of degenerate ground-state manifolds, time dynamics, and periodic systems with mixed space-time topology, demonstrating

translated_title: 拓扑结构阻碍纯态基础神经量子态
translated_abstract: 自旋-1/2系统的基态基础模型是解决从量子化学到识别新相图等众多问题的一种有前景的方法。目前几乎所有此类模型都是纯态模型，它们以哈密顿量的参数为条件，通过蒙特卡洛采样并根据变分原理给出能量估计。在这项工作中，我们证明这种表示在拓扑上是受到阻碍的。对于任何基态丛非平凡的带隙哈密顿量族，每个连续的归一化态矢量模型在哈密顿量族的某个参数值处与基态的保真度必为零。在该参数值处，能量误差至少为一个谱隙 $\Delta$，且在该点的某个开邻域内存在 $O(\Delta)$ 的能隙。我们进一步证明，在简并基态流形、时间动力学以及具有混合时空拓扑的周期系统等情形下，这一不可行性结论同样成立……
tldr: 该论文证明纯态基础神经量子态表示存在拓扑障碍：对于基态丛非平凡的带隙哈密顿量族，任何连续归一化态矢量模型必然在某些参数处与基态保真度为零，导致能量误差至少为一个谱隙。
